object_description: composition of two articulated volumes, a low teaching building and a higher research volume
design_condition: the low teaching volume attaches to the large neighbouring building while dialoguing with the moderate volumes opposite, and the entrance is grafted at the crossroads of the metro service and the main axis

positive: The project resolves a complex problem with remarkable mastery and authority
The means are simple, effective and of great formal economy
Subtle reactions to strategic points let simplicity escape simplification and schematism
The project tends towards an interesting and temperate organic rationality
The attachment of the low teaching volume to the large neighbouring building works well
So does the dialogue of this element with the moderate neighbouring volumes
The entrance graft at the crossroads of the metro service and the main axis is well placed
It is accompanied by driving the axis to a low square and relating to the respective entrances
These decisions of disconcerting simplicity address both tissues and find ways to mend them
The project does not turn its back on the landscape dimension and gives it a rightful place
The composition in two articulated volumes responds jointly to programme and site
The jury applauds this demonstration of synthesis
The quality of the interior spaces matches the relevance and precision of the exterior spaces
The plan is airy with spaces where expected, at the service of meetings
The project highlights the very notion of synergy desired by the client
Functionality works, flexibility is verified and the programme is solved
The use value of the building is good
The patios in the lower teaching building provide light and natural ventilation to satisfaction
Partially buried basements generate limited earth movements and an excellent balance of excavated masses
The spans are reasonable and the construction is economical, with average cost
negative: The compactness of the emerging research volume brings corridors lacking natural lighting
The excessively glazed facades are regrettable
Active slabs for heating and cooling limit the possibilities of reconversion
The slab thicknesses are a little limited
Floor areas are slightly higher than the programme requests
Some requested areas do not appear on the plans
